sequence.name: Bounded whole-input tokenization cache
sequence.implementation: Opt-in instance-local LRU; exact full text and special-token flags, 2 MiB conservative accounted-object bound and 128 entries. No model/conversation state or persisted cross-session cache.
sequence.status: implemented and load-free tested; Service/real-model parity and latency untested
sequence.measurement: Four independent native launches ABBA; English code/prose, cold/identical/unique full input; first content and complete Service reply, separate native TPS; one warmup plus three measured repeats per case
sequence.promotion: Fresh independent confirmation, measured repeated-input exposure and exact full-model/API/cancellation/cache follow-up required

sequence.name: Sixteen-row expert prompt tiles
sequence.implementation: Private m5-tile16 engine; original 16x64 Tensor API products, K order/scaling, route map, 128 threads, scratch/barriers retained. Separate 16-row dispatches, upper input loads skipped. No compact worklist, top10 selector or decode kernel enabled.
sequence.status: engine and paired complete-block probes built; GPU correctness and speed untested
sequence.measurement: All full two-block correctness fixtures on original P07, new engine flag off and flag on; original/candidate/candidate/original synthetic prompt screen with per-MM activation counters and zero new swap
sequence.promotion: A component pass licenses only a later fresh English full-model prompt/reply trial and independent confirmation
sequence.revisit_difference: P11/P12 altered compact worklist/grid order with original 32-row tiles. This changes dispatch width, while retaining the existing 16-row arithmetic product. Existing half-tile skipping may eliminate benefit or duplicate weight reads. No gain assumed.

stop_rules: Retain any failed/aborted result; no automatic retry, partial resume or cherry-picked passing bracket
A source/engine/rule change requires a new frozen campaign; never rewrite the historical keeper proof
Zero new swap and healthy monitoring required; only stop processes owned by a test
Qualify any gain above twice its own control drift; no fixed minimum percent, exact output and regression guards required
Do not turn on candidates or change the everyday launcher from preparation/component results
source_refresh_reason: Memory-report CLI path containment and non-overwrite hardening; original preparation never ran and is preserved as superseded.
